About Delinea:
Delinea is the identity security platform that continuously controls what AI agents, humans and machines can do and for how long. It extends privileged access management from the point of access to the moment of action, using just-in-time authorization to reduce standing privilege across on-premises, multi-cloud and short-lived infrastructure, without adding friction for legitimate users. Delinea provides visibility across every identity type, scores the risk each one carries, and preserves the context behind access decisions, making them auditable and defensible. It supports both static and ephemeral access, letting teams apply Zero Standing Privilege where risk demands it without replacing existing infrastructure.

Reporting to the SVP, GTM Operations, the Vice President, Global GTM Operations is the operating engine of Delinea’s go-to-market organization. This leader owns the planning, business cadence, and operational support that turn sales strategy into disciplined execution across Marketing, Regional Sales, Customer Experience, Partners, and SDRs. The VP leads a bench of directors who act as thought partners, not order-takers, to the senior leaders they support.

Role Summary

This role exists to raise the bar on how Delinea plans and runs its GTM business. The VP is accountable for 4 outcomes: planning that is rigorous and delivered on time; forecast and deal review cadences that stress test our deals and yield higher conversion rates and more predictability; hiring managers who have clear visibility, urgency, and accountability for filling open sales seats; and a team that earns a seat at the table by challenging assumptions and surfacing insight before it is asked for.

The ideal candidate is equally credible in an executive planning session with the President or CMO and in the detail of a forecast roll-up, a territory model, or a lead-routing rule. They are a builder of leaders, comfortable moving the team from reactive support to proactive, insight-led partnership, and relentless about driving work to completion.

Scope of the Role

Key Responsibilities & Accountabilities

· Lead the Operations Directors across Global Sales, Customer Experience, Partners, SDR and Marketing, setting clear goals, KPIs, and accountability standards

· Build a balanced onshore and near-shore operating model, with AI-enabled workflows that reduce manual effort in forecasting, inspection, reporting, and data work

· Own the annual and quarterly GTM planning calendar (resourcing, capacity, coverage, quotas, and territories), delivering each plan on time with a consistent, defensible methodology

· Translate company and GTM strategy into operating plans with clear goals, owners, milestones, and metrics

· Design, run, and improve forecast and deal review cadences (weekly forecast and pipeline inspection, deal and big deal reviews, QBRs, account health reviews) to stress test deals, lift conversion rates, and improve predictability

· Champion MEDDPICC as the sales qualification standard, embedding it in deal reviews, pipeline inspection, and forecast calls so every significant deal is rigorously stress tested

· Drive stage discipline and forecast accuracy, tracking conversion and predictability by stage, segment, and region to sharpen each round of inspection

· Build an operating calendar that connects Marketing, Sales, Customer Experience, Partners, and SDRs in one coherent rhythm

· Partner with HR, Finance, and Talent to ensure sales talent is actively managed, with open seats, backfills, and attrition clearly tracked and understood

· Give hiring managers visibility into, and accountability for, every open seat, working closely with the cross functional Sales support ecosystem of Finance, Talent Acquisition and HR

· Work with Finance, Business Systems/IT, and GTM Readiness to keep planning, reporting, and data aligned and reliable

Qualifications

· 12+ years in a global Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, GTM Strategy, or a related field, including 5+ years leading multi-function operations teams and managing managers or directors

· Demonstrated excellence in planning, including annual planning, capacity modeling, territory and quota design, and coverage models in a B2B SaaS or enterprise software environment at scale

· Proven record of building and running forecast and deal review cadences, including pipeline inspection and QBRs, that measurably improved conversion rates and forecast predictability

· Expertise in the MEDDPICC qualification methodology and a demonstrated track record of rigorous deal inspection·

· Strong executive presence, with specific examples of acting as a thought partner to C-level and senior sales or marketing leaders

· Experience partnering with HR, Finance, and Talent Acquisition to bring visibility, urgency, and accountability to sales hiring, including tracking open seats, seat aging, and time to fill against a quota capacity plan

· A history of driving cross-functional work to completion with clear ownership and follow-through, without relying on formal authority

· Track record of raising the talent level of an organization through hiring, coaching, and, when necessary, transitioning team members

· Hands-on examples of applying AI to improve forecasting, reporting, data quality, or operational productivity

· Bachelor’s degree required; MBA or equivalent advanced degree preferred

Why work at Delinea?

  • We're passionate problem-solvers helping the world's largest organizations protect what matters most: their human and machine identities.

  • We invest in people who are smart, self-motivated, and collaborative.

  • What we offer in return is meaningful work, a culture of innovation and great career progression.

At Delinea, our core values are STRONG and guide our behaviors and success:

  • Spirited - We bring energy and passion to everything we do

  • Trust - We act with integrity and deliver on our commitments

  • Respect - We listen, value different perspectives, and work as one team

  • Ownership - We take initiative and follow through

  • Nimble - We adapt quickly in a fast-changing environment

  • Global - We embrace diverse people and ideas to drive better outcomes

We believe weaving these core values into our day-to-day actions, and our process for hiring, evaluating, and promoting employees, helps us cultivate a work environment that embraces collaboration and camaraderie.

We take care of our employees. We offer competitive salaries, a meaningful bonus program, and excellent benefits, including healthcare insurance, as well as pension/retirement matching, comprehensive life insurance, an employee assistance program, time off plans, and paid company holidays.

Delinea is an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type with regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.

Upon conditional offer of employment, candidates are required to complete comprehensive criminal background check, verification of education, and verification of employment, per employment policy. In addition, all publicly posted social media sites may be reviewed.
